units.source_text: 秀男曾在四条大桥上见过不知是千重子化身的苗子，还是苗子化身的千重子。

en.t: On Shijo Bridge, Hideo had once seen Naeko, who seemed almost like an incarnation of Chieko, or perhaps Chieko as an incarnation of Naeko.

units.source_text: 因此，他想到四条大桥走走，于是朝那边走去。

en.t: So he thought he would take a walk to Shijo Bridge, and set off in that direction.

units.source_text: 但是烈日当头，十分炎热。

en.t: But the blazing sun was overhead, and it was terribly hot.

units.source_text: 他凭倚在桥栏杆上，闭上眼睛，想倾听那几乎听不见的潺潺流水声，而不是人潮或电车的轰鸣。

en.t: He leaned against the bridge railing, closed his eyes, and tried to listen for the almost inaudible murmur of the water, rather than the roar of the crowds or the streetcars.
